title: The Burning Bush

questions.question: What did Moses see burning but not consumed?
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:2 (ESV): "The angel of the Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush... the bush was burning, yet it was not consumed."

questions.question: What did God tell Moses to remove at the bush?
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:5 (ESV): "Do not come near; take your sandals off your feet, for the place on which you are standing is holy ground."

questions.question: What did God send Moses to do in Egypt?
options: Bring the Israelites out of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Bring the Israelites out of Egypt
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:10 (ESV): "Come, I will send you to Pharaoh that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt."

questions.question: What name did God reveal to Moses for Himself?
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:14 (ESV): "God said to Moses, 'I AM WHO I AM.' And he said, 'Say this to the people of Israel: I AM has sent me to you.'"

questions.question: Whose flock was Moses tending when he saw the burning bush?
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:1 (ESV): "Now Moses was keeping the flock of his father-in-law, Jethro, the priest of Midian."

questions.question: Who did God say He was to Moses at the burning bush?
options: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
questions.correctAnswer: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:6 (ESV): "I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob."

questions.question: What mountain was the burning bush located on?
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:1 (ESV): "He led his flock to the west side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God."

questions.question: What kind of land did God promise to bring the Israelites into?
options: A land of gold and silver
A land flowing with milk and honey
questions.correctAnswer: A land flowing with milk and honey
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:8 (ESV): "I have come down to deliver them... and to bring them... to a land flowing with milk and honey."

questions.question: What did Moses say would happen if the Israelites asked for God's name?
options: They would ask "What is his name?"
questions.correctAnswer: They would ask "What is his name?"
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:13 (ESV): "If I come to the people of Israel and say... 'The God of your fathers has sent me to you,' and they ask me, 'What is his name?' what shall I say to them?"

questions.question: What did God say He had seen concerning His people in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:7 (ESV): "I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt and have heard their cry."

questions.question: Which peoples did God say were inhabiting the Promised Land?
options: Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites
questions.correctAnswer: Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:8 (ESV): "To the place of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites."

questions.question: What sign did God give Moses that He had sent him?
options: That they would serve God on this mountain after leaving Egypt
A staff that turned into a serpent
questions.correctAnswer: That they would serve God on this mountain after leaving Egypt
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:12 (ESV): "This shall be the sign for you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain."

questions.question: What did God predict Pharaoh would do when asked to let Israel go?
options: Not let them go unless compelled by a mighty hand
questions.correctAnswer: Not let them go unless compelled by a mighty hand
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:19 (ESV): "But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless compelled by a mighty hand."

questions.question: What did God say the Israelites would take from the Egyptians when they left?
options: Silver and gold jewelry, and clothing
questions.correctAnswer: Silver and gold jewelry, and clothing
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:22 (ESV): "Each woman shall ask of her neighbor... for silver and gold jewelry, and for clothing. You shall put them on your sons and on your daughters."

questions.question: How did Moses react when God revealed His identity at the bush?
options: He hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God
questions.correctAnswer: He hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:6 (ESV): "And Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God."

key_verse_text: God said to Moses, ‘I AM WHO I AM.’ And he said, ‘Say this to the people of Israel: “I AM has sent me to you.”’
